key_concepts: Three types of muscle: skeletal, smooth, and cardiac
Skeletal muscle is voluntary, striated, and attached to bones
Smooth muscle is involuntary and found in hollow organs
Cardiac muscle is striated and forms the heart
Muscles contract and relax to produce movement and force
The muscular system enables movement, posture, heat production, and blood circulation
The skeletal system supports the body and gives it shape
Bones protect vital organs such as the brain, heart, and lungs
Bone marrow produces red and white blood cells
Bones and muscles work together to allow body movement
Major axial bones include the skull, rib cage, and spinal column
The appendicular skeleton includes the shoulder girdle, pelvic girdle, and limb bones
